snippet.title: Hina-chan's Sticker Survival English Trailer
snippet.description:
I've worked with mizusoba, creator of "Hina-chan's Big Trade! Millionaire Lunch," Help Me Remember, Satori-sama!", and "Reimu Needs Help!? Aunn-chan to the Rescue!" to translate his roguelite deckbuilder, "Hina-chan's Sticker Survival!".

In this one, Hina-chan's phone breaks and leaves her with no way to communicate except by sending stickers. You'll have to use clever sticker selection, 80 different Kagiyama Cards with various effects, and Marks that apply to your stickers to buff them to help her survive chats with Nitori, Joon, and Suika.

The game is available in English right now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270920/Hinachans_Sticker_Survival/
